correctness.rationale: The local neighborhood of a selected root edge is K_{n-2} square K_2. Both selected and unselected neighbors must be cliques; for n>=5 the unique maximum-clique bipartition forces a full root star, and any extra edge causes a forbidden geodesic. A separate Floyd–Warshall exhaustive checker on all 2,131,016 subsets for n=3..7 confirms the coefficient spectrum; the proof handles all n>=3.
